newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb 600 bln won from banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb 600 bln won from banks.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea plans to absorb 600 billion won of surplus liquidity from the local banking system on Friday through overnight repurchase agreements (repos), a bank official said.
"We have decided to absorb the money as banks are expected to have about 600 billion in excess of their required reserve levels today," said the official, who declined to be named.
The repos, one of the main tools the South Korean central bank uses to control liquidity, would be allocated at an auction in the morning, he said.
